title: 第13章 圆相和尚
content_zh:
破庙内，圆相却还未睡下，而是正摆着架势练拳。

    奔波这些时日，他都没有时间练武，今天难得清闲下来，肯定得练上几手了。

    练武这种事，如逆水行舟，时间一长可就得退步了。

    短期内可能看不出来，可退步却是润物细无声的。

    等真察觉到自己退步的时候，那可就已经迟了。

    一套拳打完，圆相只觉得酣畅淋漓。

    正要平息一下浑身沸腾的气血时，猛然间一声呼啸声响起。

    他根本就来不及反应，一根弩箭就朝着他射了过来。

    等他反应过来的时候，弩箭就已经射入了他的臂膀里。

    剧痛让圆相神色不由得一变，他顾不得其他，第一时间就朝着破庙的窗户一个猛扑过去。

    他一把折断了弩箭的箭柄，箭头只能等安全后再挖出来。

    结果下一刻，破庙的窗户被某种巨力给砸毁了，一颗拳头大的怪异圆珠子就这么被从窗户里掷了进来。

    “云阳弹！！！”圆相下意识地尖叫出声。

    他当然认识，这云阳弹是六扇门这朝廷鹰犬专门用来活捉江湖高手的手段之一。

    只见得那云阳弹落地，当即爆出了一阵闪光，随后涌现出大量的浓烟。

    圆相虽然立刻闭眼，同时还捂住口鼻后退，但终究还是着了道。

    那闪光本就是为了短暂致盲他的眼睛，如今闭着眼照样看不见。

    而那浓烟，也不是一般的浓烟，能持续刺激双目流泪和口鼻剧咳，同时还具备了迷烟效果。

    吸入少量就会气血萎靡、浑身无力，要是吸入过多就直接昏迷过去了。

    但这不是重点，重点是云阳弹过后还有渔网阵。

    那渔网是浸了桐油的麻绳还掺有牛筋的粗网，就算是手上有兵刃，短时间内也无法脱身。

    更何况还不是一张渔网，而是每个铁尺捕快人手一张。

    数层大网缠身，哪怕是大宗师都得束手就擒。

    别说还有钩镰枪、长杆钩爪、捕索等东西，真不怕他们逃跑。

    就算是知道了六扇门这群人的套路，可那又能如何？
content_en:
In the ruined temple, Yuan Xiang has not yet fallen asleep, but is practicing boxing in a posture.

    After traveling all these days, he didn't have time to practice martial arts. It was rare for him to have some free time today, so he would definitely have to practice a few moves.

    Martial arts training is like sailing against the current. Over time, you will have to regress.

    It may not be noticeable in the short term, but the regression is subtle and subtle.

    By the time you really notice that you are regressing, it will be too late.

    After a set of punches, Yuan Xiang felt completely refreshed.

    Just when he was about to calm down the boiling blood all over his body, a whistling sound suddenly sounded.

    He didn't even have time to react, and a crossbow arrow was shot towards him.

    By the time he reacted, the crossbow arrow had already shot into his arm.

    The severe pain caused Yuan Xiang's expression to change. He didn't care about anything else and immediately pounced towards the window of the ruined temple.

    He broke off the handle of the crossbow arrow and had to wait until it was safe to dig out the arrowhead.

    As a result, the next moment, the window of the ruined temple was smashed by some huge force, and a strange round ball as big as a fist was thrown in through the window.

    "Yun Yang Bomb!!!" Yuan Xiang screamed subconsciously.

    Of course he knew that the Yunyang Bullet was one of the methods specially used by Liumen, the imperial eagle dog, to capture martial arts masters alive.

    I saw the Yunyang bomb hit the ground, and there was a flash of light, followed by a large amount of thick smoke.

    Although Yuan Xiang immediately closed his eyes and covered his mouth and nose and retreated, he still managed to get the answer.

    The flash was meant to temporarily blind his eyes, but now he couldn't see it even with his eyes closed.

    And that thick smoke is no ordinary thick smoke. It can continuously stimulate tears in the eyes and cause severe coughing in the mouth and nose. It also has a smoke-inducing effect.

    If you inhale a small amount, your energy and blood will become sluggish and you will feel weak. If you inhale too much, you will fall into coma.

    But this is not the point. The point is that there is a fishing net formation after the Yunyang bomb.

    The fishing net was a thick net made of hemp rope dipped in tung oil and mixed with beef tendon. Even if he had a weapon in hand, he would not be able to escape in a short time.

    What's more, it's not just a fishing net, but one for each iron ruler catcher.

    Tangled in several large nets, even the Grand Master had to be caught without restraint.

    Not to mention there are hooks, sickles, long hooks, fishing ropes and other things, I am really not afraid of them escaping.

    Even if you know the tricks of the Six Doors group, what can you do?
